unit_score: indicator strength x patient intensity x evidence reliability
combination: Use diminishing returns within independent correlation groups. Repeating the same problem must not count as many independent pieces of evidence.

confidence.correction: If there is no relevant evidence, confidence must be Low / Not assessed. Do not award full completeness merely because nothing was identified.

imbalance_gate.confirmed: winning directional score >= 0.45 AND confidence >= 60% AND at least 2 independent supporting evidence units
imbalance_gate.high_priority_single: A Strong + Severe + Confirmed unit with score >= 0.70 may be shown as a high-priority candidate, but seek corroboration before final top-two confirmation.
imbalance_gate.conflicted: If both directions are meaningful and within the conflict margin, do not call the chakra imbalanced; ask clarification.
imbalance_gate.top_two: Select at most two chakras that pass the gate. If fewer than two pass, continue assessment or report that two supported findings were not established.
imbalance_gate.therapist_stop: The therapist may stop at any time; stopping does not make an unsupported chakra an imbalance.
